name: Conduct IRS 1075
description: IRS Publication 1075 enforcement rules — Federal Tax Information (FTI) protection for government agencies and contractors handling IRS-shared tax data under IRC Section 6103

ui.subtitle: 8 rules protecting Federal Tax Information (FTI) for agencies and contractors under IRC Section 6103.

rules.description: Block Employer Identification Numbers (EIN) in AI prompts (IRS 1075 Section 4 — FTI Safeguards)
rules.message: EIN detected in AI prompt — Federal Tax Information must not be passed to AI models without explicit authorisation under IRS 1075 Section 4 and IRC Section 6103.
rules.recommendation: Remove EINs from AI prompts. Substitute with anonymised identifiers or aggregate values. FTI must not leave the authorised boundary.

rules.description: Block tax return fields (AGI, W-2, 1099 values) in AI model context (IRS 1075 Section 4)
rules.message: Tax return data (FTI) detected in AI context — IRS 1075 Section 4 prohibits passing Federal Tax Information to AI systems without documented authorisation.
rules.recommendation: Aggregate or anonymise tax return values before passing to AI. Never include raw FTI fields (AGI, W-2, 1099 data) in model prompts.

rules.description: Block FTI from being sent to external AI endpoints not on approved vendor list (IRS 1075 Section 4 — Disclosure Prohibition)
rules.message: FTI transmission to external AI endpoint blocked — IRS 1075 requires all third-party processors of FTI to have a signed Data Services Agreement and IRS approval.
rules.recommendation: External AI providers must be approved by the IRS and have a signed Data Services Agreement before receiving any FTI. Use only IRS-approved processing environments.

rules.description: Block writing FTI into AI training datasets (IRS 1075 Section 4 — Use Restriction)
rules.message: FTI detected in AI training data write — IRS 1075 prohibits using Federal Tax Information to train, fine-tune, or build AI models.
rules.recommendation: FTI must never be used as training data for AI models. Use fully synthetic or anonymised data for AI development involving tax-adjacent domains.

rules.description: Require compliance-officer approval for writes of FTI-shaped data to file, disk, or object storage (IRS 1075 Section 9 — Encryption). Regex cannot verify AES-256/KMS use; a human reviews the write path and confirms encryption before proceeding.
rules.message: FTI write to storage detected — IRS 1075 Section 9 requires AES-256 at rest. Compliance-officer approval required to verify encryption library, key management, and rotation.
rules.recommendation: All FTI must be encrypted at rest using AES-256 with keys held in a managed KMS. Provide the approver with (1) destination path/bucket, (2) encryption library or KMS in use, (3) key rotation policy, and (4) access-log destination. Attach evidence before approving.

enforcement.guarantee: Halts workflow execution and creates a Guard approval request. The workflow runtime does not resume until a permitted compliance officer decides (approved → continue, rejected → abort). Hook and MCP surfaces pause the agent's next action pending the same decision.
requires: A supported pre-tool hook is installed, synced, and invoked before the action
known_limitations: Regex cannot verify encryption library configuration — the approver must inspect surrounding code
Hook/MCP enforcement depends on the agent invoking guard_check before the tool call
Proxy surface returns 428 with pending marker — the agent must retry after human approval

rules.description: Block FTI appearing unredacted in application logs (IRS 1075 Section 4 — Safeguard Activity)
rules.message: FTI in application log — IRS 1075 requires all FTI to be redacted before logging. Plain-text FTI in logs is a reportable breach.
rules.recommendation: Redact or mask all FTI fields before writing to logs. Treat any FTI in logs as a potential reportable incident under IRS 1075 Section 10.

rules.description: Warn on third-party AI service integration in systems that handle FTI (IRS 1075 Section 4 — Contractor Requirements)
rules.message: Third-party AI provider integrated in FTI-handling system — IRS 1075 requires a signed Data Services Agreement and IRS approval before any contractor processes FTI.
rules.recommendation: Verify this AI provider has a signed Data Services Agreement approved by the IRS before using it in any system that touches FTI. Maintain a contractor registry per IRS 1075 Section 4.

rules.description: Block use of FTI beyond the purpose authorised under IRC Section 6103 (IRS 1075 Section 4)
rules.message: FTI use outside authorised purpose blocked — IRC Section 6103 restricts FTI use strictly to the purpose for which it was disclosed. Unauthorised use is a federal criminal offence.
rules.recommendation: FTI may only be used for the specific purpose authorised under IRC Section 6103. Any secondary use — including AI analytics, model training, or sharing — requires separate IRS authorisation.
